# Hindi voice (MMS-TTS): the front end on the CPU (tts_front.c) and the flow and vocoder on the
# NPU (xl_voice_net.c). The two networks are generated by ST Edge AI on the PC
# (stedgeai generate --name flow / --name vocoder, see HANDOFF.md); copy each st_out folder's
# .c and .h files into networks/flow and networks/vocoder. Without them the firmware still builds
# and translates, without speech.
add_library(tts STATIC tts_front.c xl_voice_net.c)
target_include_directories(tts PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_options(tts PRIVATE -O2 -Wextra)
target_link_libraries(tts PRIVATE stedgeai)

set(XL_VOICE_FLOW_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/networks/flow)
set(XL_VOICE_VOCODER_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/networks/vocoder)
if(EXISTS ${XL_VOICE_FLOW_DIR}/stai_flow.h AND EXISTS ${XL_VOICE_VOCODER_DIR}/stai_vocoder.h)
    file(GLOB XL_VOICE_SOURCES ${XL_VOICE_FLOW_DIR}/*.c ${XL_VOICE_VOCODER_DIR}/*.c)
    add_library(tts_voice_networks STATIC ${XL_VOICE_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(tts_voice_networks PUBLIC ${XL_VOICE_FLOW_DIR} ${XL_VOICE_VOCODER_DIR})
    target_link_libraries(tts_voice_networks PUBLIC stedgeai)
    # Generated code: optimized like the vendor runtime, its warnings are ST's.
    target_compile_options(tts_voice_networks PRIVATE -O2 -w)
    target_link_libraries(tts PRIVATE tts_voice_networks)
    target_compile_definitions(tts PRIVATE XL_HAVE_VOICE_NETWORKS=1)
    message(STATUS "Hindi voice: flow and vocoder networks built in")
else()
    message(STATUS "Hindi voice: no networks in src/tts/networks (text only)")
endif()
